## Decision

Per-motive journal/ and decisions/ directories MUST NOT be deleted. They are SOURCE OF TRUTH — the store that gw journal show and gw journal compile read. Any future slice of this motive is prohibited from deleting them.

## Rationale

The tickets-only-vault motive (D-13 of that motive) wrongly classed these directories as machine-regenerated. That motive was planned on a false premise: it believed .groundwork/journal/*.jsonl JSONL shards are the authoritative store, and that per-motive journal/ dirs are generated views. In fact gw journal show/compile read .groundwork/motives/<slug>/journal/*.md and decisions/*.md as SOURCE OF TRUTH. The tickets-only-vault D-13 is therefore withdrawn. Deleting these directories would destroy the decision log irreversibly.

## Alternatives Considered
